interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add vertical speed control measures to slow traffic in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.
interventions.source: NACTO Urban Street Design Guide - Sidewalks

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Implement a regular schedule for debris removal and street sweeping to keep the walkway clear.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk at the intersection to physically slow vehicles and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Use bold, continental-style crosswalk markings to improve the visibility of the crossing area under various lighting conditions.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the grass buffer to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and create a psychological barrier between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Program
interventions.description: Establish and enforce rules for trash bin placement and regular vegetation maintenance to keep the sidewalk clear.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a safe, designated point for residents to cross.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility crosswalk with accompanying pedestrian warning signs to formalize crossing movements.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune or remove the overgrown bush to restore the full clear width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear debris and repair cracked or uneven sidewalk sections to ensure an accessible and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Tree Canopy
interventions.description: Increase the density of street trees to provide shade and help mitigate the effects of low-angle sun glare.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk/Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material across the alleyway entrance to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement physical measures like speed humps to slow vehicle speeds, reducing the risk of collisions in low-visibility conditions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or more street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical and psychological buffer from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and level the cracked sections of the sidewalk on the right side of the street to ensure a safe and accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Defined Sidewalk through Apron
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or different materials to clearly define a continuous pedestrian path across the gas station's wide driveway apron.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway to the minimum necessary to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete island in the center of the crosswalk to provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access points to the minimum necessary, shortening the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: Raised Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Carry the sidewalk material and grade across the driveway to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.
